summary.headline: Claude computes record nine-loop physics amplitude, checked by SLAC
summary.body: Another single-story day, this time about raw capability. Anthropic researchers reported that Claude computed a six-particle scattering amplitude in planar N=4 super Yang-Mills theory at nine loops, one beyond the published record, and SLAC/Stanford physicist Lance Dixon checked it. Frontier science done by AI raises Capability Velocity. That lifts every ending that needs very capable AI, from Protector God to Conquerors, and lowers Reversion. Because bright and dark endings rose together, Horizon Balance barely moved, at -9.49. Enslaved God, the boxed-genie ending where a superintelligence is kept under human lock and key, remains the clear leader at 41.92.
summary.movers_note: Enslaved God +0.3, Descendants +0.3 and Reversion -0.3, all from the Yang-Mills result (+0.34, +0.34 and -0.34).
